description: 30 owner-authorized registered PDF references. These DO NOT become independent Building-manual or finished-model approvals; show PDF rather than pretending to show official completed-model image.

questions.text: For your Bee model, can you identify and check every main assembly shown in the registered reference PDF?
Are all connected pieces on your Bee model secure, correctly aligned, and free of visibly loose parts?
Is your Bee model stable and supported in the position required for the intended demonstration?
Can you check that the sections intended to move, and the sections intended to remain fixed, are assembled without interference?
Can you safely demonstrate or explain the intended function of your completed Bee model and identify anything that still needs adjustment?
